summary: Phase Z — Chat TTL/emoji picker viewport-cutoff fix + trust_zeffy auto-approve. Backend: 13/13 pytest pass (test_phase_z.py) covering trust_zeffy flag exposure, no-trust pending, happy-path auto-approve + membership extension, 3 receipt-pattern variations (ZF- / 10-char alphanum / email), bad-pattern still-pending, and admin manual-approve regression. tx_out helper was missing 'zeffy_auto_approved' field → ADDED by testing agent so frontend can distinguish auto- vs admin-approved txs (1 test failed, then passed after fix). Frontend: chat TTL & emoji pickers verified fully inside viewport on mobile (390), tablet (768), desktop (1440); ttl-conv-grid renders 2 cols on mobile + 4 cols on tablet/desktop with no text truncation; em-trust-zeffy checkbox renders in the amber-50 callout in admin Edit Member dialog. Phase Y regression also passes 15/15.

minor.issue: Initially missing 'zeffy_auto_approved' field — review_request explicitly required this in transaction record. FIXED by testing agent (added 'zeffy_auto_approved': bool(t.get('zeffy_auto_approved')) to tx_out).

action_items: [INFO] Phase Z trust_zeffy flow is fully functional. No outstanding bugs from this iteration.
[INFO] Reset trust_zeffy=false on member@clubhaven.app applied via fixture teardown — confirmed via final GET /members/{id} returning trust_zeffy:false.

[CARRYOVER from iteration_24] Outstanding bugs still present: (1) ZeffyCheckout.jsx window.open(url,'_blank','noopener,noreferrer') returns null in Chrome/Firefox/Safari → fallback navigates current tab; (2) ZeffyDuesApprovals row removal after approve; (3) React duplicate-key warning in HoursReport.
[INFO] tx_out helper now exposes zeffy_auto_approved — frontend can use this to badge auto-approved Zeffy txs differently in admin reports if desired.
critical_code_review_comments: _is_valid_zeffy_receipt() correctly enforces 6-char min floor BEFORE pattern matching — guards against 'bad', '12345', etc. even if a pattern would otherwise match a short string.

ZEFFY_RECEIPT_PATTERNS: raw 10+ alphanumeric is UPPERCASE-only ([A-Z0-9]{10,}). 'abcdefghij' (lowercase) would NOT match raw pattern — only the email or ZF- patterns would. This is intentional but worth documenting (admins should know receipt copy-paste from emails often comes uppercase).
zeffy_confirm() auto-approve path mirrors the admin approve-zeffy logic for membership extension (base=max(current_expiry, now) + 365d). Consistent and correct.

auto-approve sets approved_by='system:zeffy-trust' (string, NOT a uuid) — distinct from manual admin approval which uses admin['id']. This is a clean audit signal but be aware any UI that joins approved_by → users will see no match for these.

tx_out was missing 'zeffy_auto_approved'. FIXED. Without this fix, frontend cannot distinguish auto-approved from admin-approved Zeffy txs in transaction lists — they look identical except for approved_by string.

Chat.jsx ttl-picker & emoji-picker use 'fixed bottom-[5.5rem] left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 w-[min(WIDTH,calc(100vw-1.5rem))] z-[60]' — pickers center above composer on ALL viewports. Verified fully inside viewport on 390/768/1440. Width-clamp gracefully handles small viewports.
ttl-conv-grid 'grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4' verified: 2 cols on 390px viewport, 4 cols on 768px+. Labels ('Off', '1 hour', '24 hours', '7 days') not truncated at any viewport.
em-trust-zeffy checkbox in Admin.jsx is inside an amber-50 callout that makes the elevated-privilege nature visually distinct — good UX. data-testid is present and discoverable.

rca of the issue: Initial pytest failure 'assert None is True' for tx['zeffy_auto_approved'] root-caused to tx_out() helper in server.py omitting that field. The auto-approve code at /payments/zeffy/confirm correctly writes zeffy_auto_approved:true to the raw doc but tx_out's projection drops it. FIX: added 'zeffy_auto_approved': bool(t.get('zeffy_auto_approved')) to tx_out (mirrors how trust_zeffy is exposed via bool() coercion in user_out). After fix, all 13 phase_z + 15 phase_y tests pass. Reproduction: PUT /api/members/{id} {trust_zeffy:true} as admin → POST /api/payments/zeffy/confirm {confirmation:'ZF-VALIDCODE',amount:60} as member → GET /api/transactions?user_id={id} as admin — pre-fix the returned tx is missing zeffy_auto_approved; post-fix it returns true.
